title: Size Shifter Expansion
description: Become a giant with heavy defense or shrink to fit into tiny gaps! Adds two unique, endgame size-changing armor sets to your world.
body:
# 🛡️ The Size Shifter Expansion

Enhance your Minecraft journey with two incredible size-altering armors! The Size Shifter Expansion introduces the powerful **Giant Armor** and the stealthy **Shrink Armor** sets, utilizing Minecraft's native attribute systems to change your physical scale and capabilities.

With the **Giant Armor**, you gain overwhelming offensive power and extreme reach, but you must navigate the world with a significantly larger hitbox.
With the **Shrink Armor**, your strength is reduced, but your minuscule size lets you slip into narrow gaps, secret passages, and 0.5-block spaces.

---

## ⚒️ How it Works

This datapack is built for the endgame. You will need elite nether-tech and deep-dark materials to forge these reality-bending sets.

* 🔴 **The Giant Armor:** Combine Netherite Ingots with **Respawn Anchors** to forge pieces of immense scale.
  
  ![Crafting recipe for the giant chestplate using netherite and respawn anchors.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a2ee7aa1186ae9495b50d5c1e9b3ae22a65dd61c.png)
  
* 🔵 **The Shrink Armor:** Combine Netherite Ingots with **Sculk Catalysts** to compress your physical matter.
  
  ![Crafting recipe for the shrink chestplate using netherite and sculk catalysts.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b3a4fb464f631562c0a9082a0bd76704e97dcc70.png)

* 📖 **Quality of Life:** All recipes are visible directly in your vanilla crafting table book, and you can track your growth and shrinkage with unique in-game advancements!

---

## 💎 Featured Items

Here is a showcase of the physical armor pieces added by this expansion:

![All armor pieces of the giant and shrink armor sets.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1ac4d8000e04eb08095c41aab70d0ab30c4aaaca.png)

<details>
<summary>🔍 Spoilers (Click to preview Full Stats & Hitbox Attributes)</summary>
  
### 🔴 1. Giant Armor Set
*Bestows massive size and juggernaut strength. Each equipped piece adds up to your total scale.*

* **Base Armor Points:** Helmet (+4) | Chestplate (+10) | Leggings (+8) | Boots (+4)
* **Armor Toughness:** +3 per piece
* **🎛️ Size Modifications (Per Piece):**
  * **+0.75 Scale** (Massively increases your visual size and physical hitbox)
  * **+5 Max Health** (2.5 extra hearts per piece)
  * **+1.5 Attack Damage** & **+2 Knockback Resistance**
  * **+3 Interaction Range** & **+0.75 Step Height** (Step over blocks easily)
  * **+0.2 Jump Strength** & **+5 Safe Fall Distance**
  * **+0.01 Base Speed**

![Stats of the giant helmet](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8db9e302ee751bbc0ac4df16575d801910d16989.png) ![Stats of the giant chestplate](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/89dc45ffed749f936796f32d6981086d3985a003.png)
![Stats of the giant leggings](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8279011287baedb7537993d7f4f8f9b309dfb1e0.png) ![Stats of the giant boots](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e7504a8d639dc3f0b48a8c47a77b54e3ce9daa2c.png)

---

### 🔵 2. Shrink Armor Set
*Shrinks you down to an ant-like scale for ultimate stealth and exploration.*

* **Base Armor Points:** Helmet (+2) | Chestplate (+6) | Leggings (+4) | Boots (+2)
* **Armor Toughness:** +3 per piece
* **🎛️ Size Modifications (Per Piece):**
  * **-0.2 Scale** (Shrinks your visual model and allows crawling into small holes)
  * **-2 Max Health** (1 less heart per piece due to your fragile size)
  * **-0.25 Interaction Range** & **-0.05 Step Height**
  * **-1 Knockback Resistance** (You get knocked back further)
  * **+3 Safe Fall Distance** (Lighter body means less fall damage)
  * **-15% Movement Speed**

![Stats of the shrink helmet](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a0b0a5d1a557acb34d1e4550b121ae41ddae70e4.png) ![Stats of the shrink chestplate](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dd5de950dec96bee1e327ed3ec614037786372f1.png)
![Stats of the shrink leggings](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/97c715be79aa129fba8e49c6553c64adf488c571.png) ![Stats of the shrink boots](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/45bad1365cfe3d808a4a5d20c6bd2d12f757a44d.png)
  
</details>

---

## ⚠️ IMPORTANT REQUIREMENTS

This datapack **requires** its corresponding Resource Pack to display textures correctly. Without it, items will appear as default vanilla objects or broken textures.

### 🛠️ Installation
1. **Datapack:** Place the `.zip` file into your `world/datapacks` folder.
2. **Resource Pack:** Place the `.zip` file into your `resourcepacks` folder and enable it in-game.

* 💡 Note: Ensure you download both files. You can find them under the Versions tab inside your preferred release:

![This image shows where to download the Datapack and Resource Pack (Versions tab).](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bdda7201b2f025d3462fd30b480aa08fe9ecfef0.png)

---

## ⚙️ Compatibility

* **Expansion Compatibility:** Fully compatible with my Armor & Tools Expansion Datapack and most other Datapacks/Mods.

---

## 📝 Behind the Scenes

- This project is a modernized version of a custom mechanic originally developed for a private Minecraft server between late 2024 and 2025 (tested for versions 1.21.3–1.21.4). 
- It was originally designed to debut as a modular feature inside the *Armor & Tools Expansion Part 2*, but has been completely overhauled and polished as a standalone release.
